title: AccountChange
description: What one released event changed in the account world (HAR-129 section 3, 5, 14, 1B): the two state snapshots, the relational state diff and the graph diff of the Neo4j projection. It adds no new facts; every field points at a stored object.

held_out_event_id.description: The replay event that caused the change; null when a live (non-replay) activity did.

previous_state_ref.description: Account-level snapshot at the diff's from_version. The state diff is account-level (state_diffs), so these refs are too: opportunity_id is null; the deal the change is about is this object's opportunity_id. A SQL trigger checks both versions against the diff.

current_state_ref.description: Account-level snapshot at the diff's to_version.

material_change.description: Equals state_diff.is_material (a composite foreign key keeps the two equal in SQL).

then.description: A material change must be traceable.
